body_encoding: Original HTTP-decoded response bytes. The body is identified by its SHA-256 hash. Cookies were neither sent nor retained.
comparison_normalization: For staged HTML comparison only, line endings are converted to LF and scripts containing both window.__CF$cv$params and /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/ are removed. Archived bodies retain these scripts verbatim.
scope: Staged public assets, both published sitemaps, well-known site metadata, and same-origin links found in captured markup, styles, and script imports. External references remain in captured bodies. Provider challenge and telemetry endpoints and transient framework navigation requests are excluded.
